Definition: from G1909 and χέω (to pour); --to pour upon:--pour in.
BiblicalUsage: Epicheo means to pour upon — and the Samaritan pours oil and wine into the wounded man's wounds, binding them up, setting him on his beast, and taking care of him.
TheologicalSignificance: What heals is poured out by a stranger who stops, at his own cost, and the oil and wine are the gospel in a picture.
